correctness.rationale: PASS: character orthogonality gives M=361+2 sum over exactly 30 positive shift representatives of integer squared aperiodic autocorrelations. Fixing the center sign by global sign invariance leaves exactly 2^18=262144 exhaustive assignments. The packaged standard C++17 Gray-code integer-update program and separately implemented Python direct 30-shift pair-product program both enumerate all assignments, independently return minimum 467, 72 fixed-center minimizers, next moment 475, and maximum 3259. The Python code independently closes all 72 minima into three disjoint orbits of 24 under 48 concrete support symmetries. Three explicit witnesses each have one-sided squared autocorrelation energy 53. No infinite statement rests on finite experiments; this is a fully finite proof by exhaustive integer verification.
